title: Portable/stacked tire-storage racks and structural evidence (Council Order 2023-03)

facts.text: The appeal concerned whether tire-storage racks were portable and outside the Code or fixed/stacked equipment subject to NBC(AE) 2019; the respondent’s order concerned the racks in a distribution building.

The order describes a preliminary engineering study that reviewed rack specifications, site observations, code provisions, desktop analysis, SAP2000 modeling and in-house tests; the reported study did not model back-to-back rack systems used at the site.
The order says the study reported large lateral deflections for three- and four-high stacks and identified further testing/manufacturer information as needed.

limitations: The underlying engineering reports, raw test data and drawings are not attached separately.
